newsitem.title: UK: UK mobile phone operators gain on subscriber data.
newsitem.headline: UK mobile phone operators gain on subscriber data.

text.p: Shares in British mobile phone operators Orange Plc and Vodafone Plc pushed higher on Wednesday, lifted by what dealers called favourable new subscriber numbers released this week.
Orange was up two pence or just over one percent at 189-1/2p while Vodafone gained 2-1/2p or 1.1 percent to 224p. The overall market was up by around half a percent.
Orange said on Wednesday it had gained a net 86,000 customers in the third quarter, bringing its subscriber base to 659,000 and giving it more than 10 percent of the total UK mobile phone market.
On Tuesday, Vodafone said it added 185,000 net new worldwide subscribers during the third quarter, a rise of 31 percent, bringing its subscriber base to almost 3.5 million.
